decision: On 2026-10-01 agalwood authorized corrective revisions until the first formal Release succeeds, with the same 42 residual Action advisories (1 Critical, 18 High, 19 Medium, 4 Low) and unchanged 2026-10-15 UTC deadline. This fresh exact-scope record binds only v9.0.2-motrix.8, its source lock, every unchanged workflow byte, the unchanged complete same-day audit 36807648066 and official full-SHA Action references. The .8 correction archives the same single bounded, binary, race-checked BUILD-INFO read used for complete strict JSON/schema/provenance validation, preserving approved bytes verbatim. All exact final byte comparisons and malformed/duplicate/unknown-record, source, configure, license and architecture checks remain. No workflow, Action, source archive/URL, toolchain, cache policy, dispatch/API/artifact binding, Secret surface/permission, keychain isolation, certificate pin, hardened runtime, timestamp, notarization or publication authority changes. Existing strict Base64, isolated Windows packaging/risk checks, protected readers, deterministic macOS baseline and NASM evidence remain. Publication still requires exact-commit CI, size/race/hash/byte checks, independent rebuilds, platform signing/notarization, pinned Ed25519 authentication, independent final verification, Immutable Releases and fresh human Environment confirmations. All seven prior tags remain immutable; no prior scope, approval or run-specific signature/notarization evidence is reused for .8. Further corrections require fresh exact-scope records. New advisories, deadline extensions or unrelated source/Action updates require a new human decision. This limited decision grants no Environment approval, no exception for another tag or unknown scope, and no publication after the deadline.
